record.context_brief: Explicit cycle bases over fields of odd characteristic
record.original_question: When k is a field of characteristic different from 2 and G is a 3-edge-connected graph, does the cycle space C(G) admit a natural explicit basis consisting of cycles indexed by the edges of G?

evidence.quote: Question: Is there a nice explicit basis for C(G) consisting of cycles indexed by E, assuming G is 3-edge-connected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic different from $2$, and let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite 3-edge-connected graph (a connected graph in which the removal of any set of at most two edges leaves the graph connected). Fix an arbitrary orientation of each edge in $E$. Define the (oriented) cycle space $C(G)$ to be the kernel of the boundary map $\partial:k^{E}\to k^{V}$ sending each oriented edge $e=(u,v)$ to $v-u$; equivalently, $C(G)$ is the $k$-vector space of $k$-valued flows on $G$. Its dimension equals $|E|-|V|+1$, which in general is strictly less than $|E|$.

Question: Does there exist a natural, explicit construction that, for every such $G$, produces a spanning family of cycles in $C(G)$ indexed by the edges $e\in E$ (one cycle $\gamma_e \in C(G)$ for each edge $e$, defined by a uniform combinatorial rule), such that some canonical sub-family or canonical $k$-linear combination of the $\gamma_e$ forms a basis of $C(G)$? More precisely, is there a nice explicit basis of $C(G)$ whose elements are cycles canonically indexed by the edges of $G$, under the assumption that $G$ is 3-edge-connected?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a definitive resolution of the question of whether 3-edge-connected graphs admit a natural explicit cycle-space basis indexed by edges over fields of odd characteristic. While there is substantial literature on minimum cycle bases, lattice cycle bases, and inductive constructions for 3-edge-connected graphs, no source clearly answers this specific question affirmatively or negatively. The status is therefore taken to be unknown.

status_evidence.title: Cycle Bases in Graphs: Characterization, Algorithms, Complexity, and Applications
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of cycle bases including minimum, fundamental, and integral cycle bases, but does not present an edge-indexed natural basis specific to 3-edge-connected graphs over odd-characteristic fields.
status_evidence.claim: The standard surveys on cycle bases do not record an explicit edge-indexed basis construction answering the question.

status_evidence.title: The Lattice of Cycles of an Undirected Graph
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses inductive constructions of lattice cycle bases for 3-edge-connected graphs via topological one-edge extensions.
status_evidence.claim: Inductive constructions exist, but no canonical edge-indexed natural basis is established.
